```{python}
#| label: fig-measurement-errors
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Classification of measurement errors: accuracy is ensured by instrument traceability to standards, while precision splits into repeatability (same person, machine, and setup) and reproducibility (different person, machine, or setup)."

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle


def box(ax, x, y, w, h, text):
    ax.add_patch(Rectangle((x - w / 2, y - h / 2), w, h, fc='white',
                           ec='k', lw=1.0))
    ax.text(x, y, text, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=8.5)


def link(ax, x0, y0, x1, y1):
    ym = (y0 + y1) / 2
    ax.plot([x0, x0, x1, x1], [y0, ym, ym, y1], 'k-', lw=1.0)


fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 3.6))

box(ax, 6.0, 5.4, 3.4, 0.75, 'Measurement errors')
box(ax, 2.6, 4.0, 2.4, 0.75, 'Accuracy')
box(ax, 9.4, 4.0, 2.4, 0.75, 'Precision')
box(ax, 2.6, 2.4, 3.4, 1.0, 'Instrument traceability\nto standards')
box(ax, 7.2, 2.4, 2.6, 0.75, 'Repeatability')
box(ax, 11.4, 2.4, 2.7, 0.75, 'Reproducibility')
box(ax, 7.2, 0.8, 2.8, 1.1, 'Same person\nSame machine\nSame setup')
box(ax, 11.4, 0.8, 2.9, 1.1, 'Different person\nDifferent machine\nDifferent setup')

link(ax, 6.0, 5.03, 2.6, 4.38)
link(ax, 6.0, 5.03, 9.4, 4.38)
ax.plot([2.6, 2.6], [3.62, 2.9], 'k-', lw=1.0)
link(ax, 9.4, 3.62, 7.2, 2.78)
link(ax, 9.4, 3.62, 11.4, 2.78)
ax.plot([7.2, 7.2], [2.02, 1.35], 'k-', lw=1.0)
ax.plot([11.4, 11.4], [2.02, 1.35], 'k-', lw=1.0)

ax.set_xlim(0.4, 13.3)
ax.set_ylim(0, 6.0)
ax.axis('off')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
